name: plexbridge
description: A Plex-compatible music bridge for provider-backed libraries

scripts.format: biome format --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: biome format src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.plex:login: PLEXBRIDGE_CONFIG_DIR=./config npm run build && PLEXBRIDGE_CONFIG_DIR=./config node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli/auth.js
scripts.plex:claim: PLEXBRIDGE_CONFIG_DIR=./config npm run build && PLEXBRIDGE_CONFIG_DIR=./config node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli/claim.js
scripts.plex:register: PLEXBRIDGE_CONFIG_DIR=./config npm run build && PLEXBRIDGE_CONFIG_DIR=./config node --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/src/cli/register.js
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && node --test dist/tests/api.test.js dist/tests/certificate.test.js dist/tests/navidrome-client.test.js
scripts.dev: PLEXBRIDGE_CONFIG_DIR=./config npm run build && node scripts/dev.mjs
